why_by_stat.Crush: Mainly useful in PVP. Reduces the enemy’s Block Rate 1%-for-1%, making it easier for Dellons to land Critical Hits and deal more damage to tanky enemies.
why_by_stat.DMGAmp: Increases all damage dealt by Dellons by the given %, making it useful for both general damage and higher PVE scores. Also increases DOT damage.

dedicated.story:
"I saw your sword, Snolled, and it looked very worn — too worn to properly protect me with. From now on, use this sword to guard me."
"Understood, Princess. With this, I vow to protect you at all costs."

Upon receiving the two swords gifted by Claudia, Snolled pledged to keep her safe for the rest of his life. As time passed and he became Dellons, he gripped his blackened blade and reflected upon that promise of old. The tragedy of failing to protect the one he loved, his burning thirst for vengeance, and his still-enduring vow all converged into a chilling, steely resolve.

lore:
Together with the Dark Knights, Dellons ultimately succeeded in seizing Karin. The Power of Destruction condensed within Karin's body had already grown so vast that a new Stone of Destruction had already begun to take shape. And to Dellons, that power was all too painfully familiar — a power he had lost long ago, yet never once forgotten.

As he embraced the overflowing Power of Destruction, Dellons's very existence was transformed. His magical abilities surged wildly, amplifying exponentially, while his physical body grew incomparably resilient. Witnessing this transformation, Mercure was horrified, but filled with conviction at the same time. He became convinced that if this power could be studied, they could save the dying world of Telus.

Without hesitation, Dellons offered up his own body as a test subject. From the extraction of his blood to even perilous experiments involving the creation of his own clones, he refused nothing. No matter how brutal the experiments, or how much his flesh was torn and his magical energy was ravaged in the process, he never once let out even a single scream. He simply surrendered his body to the operating table with an eerie calm, as if anesthesia was an unnecessary indulgence.

His dedication was so fervent that it bordered on maniacal obsession, and even Mercure was left speechless. And so, Dellons gradually transformed into something far beyond the realm of humanity.
